name: Paytm

snapshot.about: Acquires merchants and consumers through payments and cross-sells financial services, particularly credit.

narrative: Management's revenue growth guidance of 22% was exceeded by reported growth of 28% in Q1 and Q2 FY27, while payment margins surpassed four basis points. However, reported net profit did not translate into positive operating cash flow.

promises.statement: Paytm expects payment processing margins to remain above 4 basis points over the next few quarters.

said.quote: But we feel pretty confident that it will stay above four basis points for the next few quarters

actual_source.quote: both your GMV up 27%, and the margins are moving from less than three to more than four basis points

promises.note: Net payment margins exceeded four basis points, reaching 8.4 bps in Q1 FY27 and 9 bps in Q2 FY27.

promises.statement: Management targets reaching a 15-20% EBITDA margin over the next two to three years.

said.quote: So on EBITDA margin when you say that now you have higher visibility on the 15-20% margin number in the next two to three years

actual_source.quote: The thing is that we probably announced 8% of EBITDA margin this quarter

promises.note: EBITDA margins expanded sequentially to eight percent in Q1 FY27 and ten percent in Q2 FY27.

promises.statement: Paytm aims to build and monetize a base of 250 million customers over the next 3 to 5 years.

said.quote: I'm going to say about 250 million customers is a good number for us to aim for

promises.statement: Company plans to add 25 to 30 lakh merchants annually.

said.quote: So we have said broadly 25 to 30 lakhs additions a year

promises.statement: Management expects a 2.5 bps improvement in payment processing margin from UPI MDR implementation.

said.quote: We just tried, in fact, looking at the most conservative method. And then we found out 2.5 bps is something that we can make

promises.statement: The company has board approval to invest up to 500 crore rupees into PCTL over 12 months.

said.quote: So when we went to the board, we took an enabling resolution that we can put up to 500 crores in the subsidiary

promises.metric: Indirect expense growth vs CM growth
promises.statement: Indirect expenses should grow at less than half of revenue or contribution margin growth over 3 to 4 quarters.

said.quote: indirect expenses, including higher expenses in marketing and sales and service and cloud expenses, et cetera, should over a three to four quarter period, grow at less than half of revenue growth, right

promises.statement: Company is guiding for more than 22% growth in revenue for FY27.

said.quote: And lastly, on costs and margin, we are guiding for more than 22% growth

promises.statement: Management expects to reach EBITDA margins of 15% to 20% in about two and a half to three years.

said.quote: And EBITDA, we will maintain about two and a half to three years from now, that we should be able to get to those sorts of EBITDA margins

promises.statement: Absolute EBITDA will continue to expand quarter on quarter next quarter despite the DLG drag.

said.quote: What we have said is there's a huge amount of tailwinds in the businesses overall, including in the merchant lending business, that we don't think that we're looking at EBITDA going down next quarter

promises.statement: Paytm expects BNPL monthly disbursals to cross 100 crore within six months of launch.

said.quote: And within six months of launch, we expect to cross hundred crores of disbursal

promises.statement: Management expects at least 30% to 40% of the PIDF impact to be offset in Q4 FY26.

said.quote: Our expectation is at least 30 - 40 percent of this will be offset this quarter and more over time

signals.quote: Operating cash flow was negative in FY26 while reported profit was positive.

cash.read: Profits fail to generate cash: operating cash flow turned negative in FY26 despite reported profitability, while cumulative five-year free cash flow stands at −₹3,832 crore.

bull.point: Revenue growth accelerated to 28% year-on-year in Q1 and Q2 FY27, exceeding earlier full-year guidance of 22%.

evidence.quote: And lastly, on costs and margin, we are guiding for more than 22% growth
For example, if you grew 28% YoY, are there any downward pressures on revenues at all in the foreseeable future
Yeah, so yes, we have now seen two consistent quarters of 28% growth

bull.point: Net payment margins expanded to 8.4 basis points in Q1 FY27 and 9 basis points in Q2 FY27, remaining above guidance.

evidence.quote: But we feel pretty confident that it will stay above four basis points for the next few quarters
in the letter you guys say that the net payment margins went from 8.8 bps last year to 8.4
And Suraj, the evidence of that is in the point that Vijit was mentioning, that eight and a half has gone to nine, which is the net payment margin number

bull.point: EBITDA margin improved sequentially from 6% in FY26 to 8% in Q1 FY27 and 10% in Q2 FY27.

evidence.quote: ended the year at about 6% with very strong expansion
The thing is that we probably announced 8% of EBITDA margin this quarter

bear.point: Operating cash flow was negative in FY26 despite reported profit, with cumulative five-year free cash flow reaching −₹3,832 crore.

bear.point: Enforcement Directorate issued a Show Cause Notice alleging contraventions of Foreign Exchange Management Act rules against the entity and two subsidiaries.

evidence.quote: Notice ("SCN") received by the Company and its two subsidiaries, from the Directorate of Enforcement, Government of India alleging contraventions of certain provisions of the Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999

bear.point: Unrecognised deferred tax assets remain substantial, with brought forward losses and deductible temporary differences totaling ₹9,392 crore.

evidence.quote: Brought forward losses and deductible temporary differences for which no deferred tax asset is recognised in the Standalone Balance Sheet
